videos.title: The tech that made a 2-hour marathon possible | The Vergecast
videos.description:
At this year's London Marathon, two runners completed the route in under two hours, becoming the first people to ever do so on an official course. It's a feat that Outside magazine's Alex Hutchinson once thought wouldn't be accomplished until 2075. The Verge's senior policy reporter (and marathoner) Lauren Feiner talks to Alex about "super shoes" and the other surprising technological advances that led to this moment.

videos.title: Hands-on with Xiaomi’s new 18 Fold
videos.description:
The Verge’s news editor, Dominic Preston, got hands-on with Xiaomi’s new 18 Fold and its the phone he wished Samsung made. It has a triple camera, big battery, and new Arm GPU to name a few upgrades. Plus, with a roughly 1.4:1 aspect ratio on both the 7.58-inch inner and 5.38-inch outer screens, it’s almost an exact match for both international paper sizes and IMAX screens. Which means you can probably watch The Odyssey as Christopher Nolan intended.

videos.title: Robots are taking over IFA
videos.description:
All over IFA, there were robots trying to talk, walk, or strut for us. Companies are increasingly bringing humanoid robots to consumer electronics trade shows, pushing them as household helpers and companion bots. But we have yet to see the autonomy and function catch up to the impressive hardware. Right now, it’s still just a runway show.
